389:t_1:86.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Truth is, there are times when guys like us can't make sense of the younger generation.」

389:t_1:87.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$カミーユ$$, $$シン$$, $$キラ$$, $$バナージ$$, $$クェス$$, $$カツ$$, $$ハサウェイ$$, $$ガロード$$, $$ヒイロ$$, $$五飛$$... They're all beyond my understanding.」

389:t_1:88.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We finally agree on something, $$シャア$$.」

389:t_1:89.en:
$$シャア$$
「It means you, too, are no longer in a position where being a pilot is all you need to be.」

389:t_1:90.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ブライト$$ was worried about you, too. He wants you to grow up quickly in your private life as well.」

389:t_1:91.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I wish Pops would cut me some slack.」

389:t_1:92.en:
$$ランド$$
(How long is this pointless rambling going to go on...)

389:t_1:93.en:
$$ランド$$
(Doing this without even a drop of booze... Is that the power of old guys...?)

389:t_1:94.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Doesn't this feel like some old guys' gripe-fest?」

389:t_1:95.en:
$$マリ$$
「Why not go join in? I think it'd be a great chance to vent all that pent-up frustration, nya.」

389:t_1:96.en:
$$チコ$$
「Frustration? You've been bottling that stuff up...?」

389:t_1:97.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I-I'm fine! You don't need to worry!」

389:t_1:100.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$アスカ$$... Before you joined us, I'd already heard about you... That you and I kind of overlap in character.」

389:t_1:101.en:
$$チコ$$
「But when I actually met you, it was different... ...You're more grown-up than I expected.」

389:t_1:104.en:
$$マリ$$
「That self-mocking way of putting it... Let me guess: you're refusing to become an adult, aren't you?」

389:t_1:106.en:
$$マリ$$
「But you can't stay an eternal boy forever... I bet that gap is going to make you suffer.」

389:t_1:107.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I don't much like how you talk, deciding things about people.」

389:t_1:108.en:
$$マリ$$
「Remember this, $$ニコラ$$. A real boy always wants, deep down, to become a grown-up.」

389:t_1:109.en:
$$マリ$$
「Being a boy isn't the opposite of being an adult... It means you're on your way to becoming one.」

389:t_1:111.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$ニコラ$$... Don't tell me you...」

389:t_1:112.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Whoa there, $$チコ$$. Don't go blabbing anything unnecessary to the Princess.」

389:t_1:113.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Just so you know, for me 《$$あがり$$》 is still a long way off.」

389:t_1:115.en:
$$マリ$$
(Twisted, aren't they, this one and that one...)

389:t_1:116.en:
$$ランド$$
(It's been an hour now... How is this training, $$クロウ$$...?)

389:t_1:117.en:
$$オットー$$
「Are you listening, $$ランド・トラビス$$!」

389:t_1:119.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「In the first place, you... Even in battle you charge in headlong, or rather, you don't see what's around you...」

389:t_1:120.en:
$$大杉$$
「In $$ランド$$'s case that is his natural strength, but the fact that it goes rather too far is the problem, I'd say.」

389:t_1:121.en:
$$イアン$$
「Repairing on the battlefield is fine and all, but sometimes your methods are far too forceful.」

389:t_1:122.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「That's right. A machine isn't fine just because it runs.」

389:t_1:123.en:
$$ランド$$
(The tide's... starting to turn against me here...)

389:t_1:127.en:
$$ランド$$
(It's bringing back memories, for the first time in ages, of when my old master drilled the ABCs of repair into me as a kid.)

389:t_1:129.en:
$$隼人$$
「The point of this training is to put stress on both mind and body, but physical pain would probably work faster.」

389:t_1:132.en:
$$隼人$$
「This is for your own good, too.」

389:t_1:133.en:
$$ランド$$
「Wait! I've heard that kind of line from my old master more than enough!」

389:t_1:134.en:
$$オットー$$
「I don't want to hear excuses! Consider this part of your instruction!」

389:t_1:135.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「A fleet believed to be $$サイデリアル$$ is approaching. Captain $$オットー$$, please come up to the bridge immediately.」

389:t_1:136.en:
$$オットー$$
「You heard her! All hands, to your posts!」

389:t_1:138.en:
$$シャア$$
「A $$サイデリアル$$ fleet... Then...」

389:t_1:139.en:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah, I can feel it...! Here comes that jerk $$ストラウス$$!」

389:t_2:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Sounds like a lot happened in the $$残されの海$$ too.」

389:t_2:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「Did you get more sunburned, $$レド$$?」

389:t_2:7.en:
$$レド$$
「I got to spend a few days with the fleet.」

389:t_2:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「A few days...? But you were off on your own for about a month, weren't you?」

389:t_2:9.en:
$$レド$$
「Actually... I parted ways with $$アルト$$ and the others too, and was somewhere other than the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

389:t_2:10.en:
$$勝平$$
「What were you doing, Big Bro $$レド$$?」

389:t_2:11.en:
$$レド$$
「I was wiping out the $$クジライカ$$s.」

389:t_2:12.en:
$$レド$$
「...The $$クジライカ$$s were $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ that had adapted to Earth's environment.」

389:t_2:14.en:
$$マオ$$
「I heard this before, but don't the fleet's people revere those $$クジライカ$$s as messengers of the gods or something...」

389:t_2:15.en:
$$レド$$
「That's why $$エイミー$$ and the fleet's people were against me laying a hand on the $$クジライカ$$s.」

389:t_2:16.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「So that's how it was: $$レド$$ and I split off from $c and headed for their nest.」

389:t_2:17.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Why does $$ピニオン$$ come into it?」

389:t_2:18.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「There was treasure in their nest... The legacy of a dead civilization was sleeping there.」

389:t_2:19.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「$$レド$$ wanted the $$クジライカ$$s exterminated and I wanted to salvage the treasure, so our interests lined up.」

389:t_2:20.en:
$$レド$$
(That was where I learned what the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ really are...)

389:t_2:21.en:
$$レド$$
(But I have no intention of telling anyone this... If the time ever comes when it's needed, I can reveal it then...)

389:t_2:22.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Surprises kept coming after that, too. Believe it or not, someone from $$レド$$'s past showed up.」

389:t_2:23.en:
$$宗介$$
「Someone $$レド$$ knows... In other words, a person from the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

389:t_2:24.en:
$$レド$$
「Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ was my superior officer.」

389:t_2:25.en:
$$レド$$
「The Lieutenant Colonel was trying to build, by force, a social system like the $$人類銀河同盟$$'s here on this $$翠の地球$$.」

389:t_2:26.en:
$$甲児$$
「You mean... he tried to rule over people?」

389:t_2:27.en:
$$レド$$
「Exactly. ...But apparently, in the middle of that ambition, Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ was struck down by an endemic disease and lost his life.」

389:t_2:28.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hold on! Then your story doesn't add up!」
